projection_note: The reference is a photograph of a cylinder. Every width measured from it is an APPARENT (projected) width, compressed towards the flanks. The flat artwork width needed to reproduce it when wrapped is a different quantity and is NOT derived here: no wrap model has visible evidence to support it (§7). VQ-2 therefore compares candidate against reference in APPARENT space only — the candidate is rendered with the same front-facing projection as the reference, so like is compared with like.
margin_note: left 33 px vs right 32 px at the widest line — consistent with an artwork block that is optically centred, so the centerline datum is corroborated rather than assumed.

visible_curvature_effect.interpretation: The DAMASCENA baseline in the reference is an ARC, not a line: a straight fit leaves 3.76 px of residual. This is the cylinder projecting away from the camera, not a baseline defect in the artwork. VQ2-A1 therefore sets a STRAIGHT baseline; reproducing the arc would bake a photographic projection into flat artwork.

occluded_areas: the right flank beyond ~x 815, where body shading and foreshortening make ink indistinguishable
the rear of the container (not visible at all)
